description.intro: The Rinat Cohesive Tape 7.5 cm x 4.5 m adhesive bandage is designed to keep shin guards and other well placed protections during workouts and matches. Its elastic and self-adhesive construction is fixed on itself to provide a stable hold without attaching directly to the skin.
key_benefits: Well-attached shin guards: Helps keep the protections in position during the game's own movements.
Fixation on itself: Its cohesive design allows to secure the bandage without attaching directly to the skin or hair.
Flexible adjustment: Its elasticity makes it easy to adapt the tension around the leg while maintaining freedom of movement.
Versatile fastening: Can be used to fix shin, stockings and other sports bandages during activity.
